GEMS GROUP
processed
Company Profile, Services and Employee Policy
Owner: David Gems
1. About Gems Group
Gems Group is a multi-service company that brings together software development, artificial intelligence
and automation, travel services, and digital marketing under one roof. Alongside its commercial work, the
group runs a social support program for children, supports independent film production, and sponsors
motorsport through Gems Racing. The group's approach is to combine practical business services with a
commitment to supporting people and communities.
Our mission is to deliver reliable, modern services to our clients while using the strength of the group to
create opportunities for children, storytellers, and athletes who would otherwise have limited access to
support.
2. Our Locations
Gems Group operates across three countries, allowing us to serve clients and partners in each market
while drawing on a diverse team and a wide network:
• United States
• India
• Vietnam
3. Our Services
3.1 Software Services
Our software team designs, builds, and maintains digital products for businesses of every size. We work
with companies to understand their goals and then deliver web applications, mobile solutions, custom
business systems, and integrations with the tools they already use. Our process focuses on clear
requirements, transparent timelines, quality testing, and long-term support after launch.
3.2 AI and Automation
Gems Group helps organizations put artificial intelligence to practical use. We identify repetitive, time-
consuming work and design automated workflows that save time and reduce errors. Our AI solutions
include intelligent chat assistants, document processing, data analysis tools, and process automation that
connects existing software. We focus on responsible deployment, so every solution is tested, explained
to the people who use it, and built to fit real business needs.

3.3 Travel Services
Our travel division helps individuals, families, and corporate teams plan and book journeys across the
United States, India, Vietnam, and beyond. Services include itinerary design, flight and accommodation
booking, tour arrangements, group travel coordination, and corporate travel management. Because we
operate in three countries, we can offer local knowledge and dependable on-the-ground support for
travelers.
3.4 Digital Marketing
Gems Group's digital marketing team helps businesses grow their visibility and reach the right customers.
We offer search engine optimization, social media management, paid advertising campaigns, content
creation, email marketing, and website analytics. Each campaign starts with clear goals and is measured
regularly so that clients can see what is working and where to invest next.
3.5 Mai International Children's Foundation
Through the Mai International Children's Foundation, Gems Group supports children who do not have
financial support for their education. The group takes on the full cost of studies for the children it
sponsors, covering the fees and essential learning expenses so that financial hardship does not stand in
the way of a good education. Our goal is to give these children a stable path to school, to a future career,
and to a better life.
The foundation welcomes referrals from schools, community leaders, and families who know a child in
need. Every child selected is supported from the start of their education to its completion, with progress
followed closely by our team.
3.6 Film Production
Gems Group believes that good stories deserve to be told on screen. If you have a story for a film, our
production support team will review it and, where it is a strong fit, help take the project forward. Our
support can include development of the script, financing, casting, crew coordination, filming, and post-
production. We are interested in stories that inspire, educate, or give a voice to people whose experiences
are rarely shown.
3.7 Gems Racing Support
Gems Racing supports motorsport athletes and teams by providing the resources they need to compete
at their best. Our support can include sponsorship, team management assistance, sponsor and media
coordination, event logistics, and promotional services. We believe that racing builds discipline,
teamwork, and determination, and we are proud to help drivers and teams pursue their goals on the track.
4. Working Hours
| Days | Working Hours |
| --- | --- |
| Monday to Saturday | 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM |
| Sunday | Closed (weekly off) |

| Days | Working Hours |
| --- | --- |
| Public Holidays | Closed |
Employees are expected to be available during the standard working hours above. Any change to these
hours for a specific team or project will be communicated in writing by management.
5. Leave Policy
Each employee receives a total of 22 days of leave per year. The annual leave allocation is divided into the
categories below.
| No. | Leave Category | Annual Days |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Casual Leave (CL) | 6 |
| 2 | Sick Leave (SL) | 6 |
| 3 | Earned Leave (EL) | 4 |
| 4 | Annual Leave | 2 |
| 5 | Privilege Leave (PL) | 2 |
| 6 | Maternity / Paternity Leave | As per company policy |
| 7 | Unpaid Leave (LWP) | As required |
| 8 | Other Leave Categories | 2 |
|  | Total allocated | 22 days |
Leave requests should be submitted to your manager in advance whenever possible. Sick leave should be
reported on the day of absence. Unused earned leave may be carried forward as set by management.
Unpaid leave is granted only when the allocated leave balance has been used or when required by
circumstances approved by management.
6. Related Policies and Guidelines
6.1 Code of Conduct
All employees are expected to act with honesty, respect, and professionalism toward colleagues, clients,
partners, and the children and communities we serve. Harassment, discrimination, and misuse of
company resources are not tolerated.
6.2 Confidentiality and Data Protection

Client information, project details, financial records, and personal data of employees and beneficiaries
must be kept confidential and used only for authorized purposes. Employees must follow data protection
rules applicable in the United States, India, and Vietnam.
6.3 Use of Company Resources
Company equipment, software licenses, and accounts should be used for business purposes. Employees
are responsible for keeping their login credentials secure and for reporting any suspected security incident
promptly.
6.4 Grievance and Feedback
Employees who have a concern about their workplace or a policy may raise it with their manager or with
the management team. Concerns will be treated seriously, handled fairly, and kept as confidential as
possible.
7. Contact and Support
For questions about our services, the Mai International Children's Foundation, film submissions, Gems
Racing, or internal policies, please contact the Gems Group support team:
• Support email: gems7.divine@gmail.com
• Company owner: David Gems
• Offices: United States, India, and Vietnam
This document is provided for information purposes and may be updated from time to time. Where it
conflicts with a signed contract or a written instruction from management, the signed contract or written
instruction takes precedence.
